2973: Supported by the Government of Karnataka, the courses led by faculty from IIM Bangalore and industry experts cover essential managements concepts relating to strategy, people management, finance, product management and regulation, apart from providing a basic exposure to the business of key verticals such as lending, payments, insurance and wealth tech. Batch 1 was offered in two tiers: a six-month Foundation Certificate followed by a three-month Advanced Certificate. Every course included live online sessions, and course transcripts were provided in both Kannada and English to make the programme accessible to learners across the state. The curriculum has been designed to empower learners to pursue roles including that of product managers, strategists or fintech entrepreneurs in one of India’s fastest-growing sectors. Alongside continuous assessments on the IIMBx Direct platform, learners had to clear Foundation, Intermediate and Advanced level examinations. All three were conducted in person, as proctored exams at physical test centres.
